name: knowledge
label: Knowledge: LightRAG graph-RAG instances and a reranker, reached only through this node

defaults._doc: instances: one per knowledge group, each its own server and data folder, managed through /knowledge (none to begin with). Each group names its own chat and embedding model ({source, model}: source empty for this node, else one of remote.sources); LLM_MODEL, EMBEDDING_MODEL and EMBEDDING_DIM are filled from them when its server starts, EMBEDDING_DIM measured from the model unless the group gives it. allowed: the only paths a client can reach. Its LLM and embedding calls come back through this node, so they queue with everything else. capabilities: how each contract capability is asked of the knowledge program (path, method, body from the request's fields, query: the URL's query from them with query_add as defaults, as: the name a bare-list answer is given, map from its answer to the contract's result, text: the part of the answer that is the reply). query_options: the program's own query options, listed with each group so a caller can offer them without knowing the program. pages: how a list is gathered over all its pages when no page is asked for (the program's largest page). replace: adding under a name the group holds replaces it, and the same content again is not sent. stored: answered from a file the program keeps in the group's folder ({file: a pattern under that folder, key: the entry, take: the part that is the text}), for what the program has no route for - knowledge_document reads one document's whole text this way from the JSON store LightRAG writes by default; with another storage setting the entry has to name that. forget: once the call has succeeded the record of what was added (added.json) is cleared - knowledge_clear, which empties the group and keeps it. program_settings: the knowledge program's own settings a group may set (shown under Program settings in its form), each given to that group's server as an environment variable; a group that sets none uses the program's defaults.

mode.label: Way of searching
mode.hint: mix: graph and passages together; local: around the entities found; global: over the relations; hybrid: local and global; naive: passages only; bypass: nothing retrieved, the model answers alone.

enable_rerank.label: Rerank results
enable_rerank.hint: Uses a reranker model if the server has one configured.

only_need_context.label: Retrieved context only
only_need_context.hint: Gives what was retrieved and skips the program's own writing pass.

chunk_size.label: Chunk size (tokens)
chunk_size.hint: How long each piece of a document is when it is split for reading and embedding. The program's default is 1200. Applies to documents added after the change; documents already in keep their pieces until added again.

chunk_overlap.label: Chunk overlap (tokens)
chunk_overlap.hint: How much each piece repeats of the one before it. Default 100.

top_k.label: Entities and relations found per question

max_async.label: Model requests at the same time
max_async.hint: Default 4: as many as a small model's server serves at once (llama.parallel on its node); more wait in the node's queue. Lower it for a large model on a slow machine, where waiting requests may reach the program's timeout.

max_graph_nodes.label: Most graph nodes it gives at once
max_graph_nodes.hint: This node sets 10000 (the program's own default is 1000): its ceiling on a graph view, whatever number the view asks for. Larger graphs take longer to draw and more memory in the browser.

max_parallel_insert.label: Documents read at the same time
max_parallel_insert.hint: Default 2. Each document's pieces share the model requests above; the program suggests about a third of them.

rerank.hint: A reranker pulls in PyTorch: leave off unless wanted

install._why: LightRAG counts tokens with tiktoken's o200k_base, which tiktoken otherwise downloads at the first start, from inside a network with no approved contact; the file name is the SHA-1 of the URL, as tiktoken caches it

instances.hint: the knowledge groups on this node, each with its own models
instances.label: Knowledge groups

adapters.reranker.enabled.label: Reranker
adapters.reranker.enabled.hint: true runs a small reranking model on this node (downloaded at its first start)
